title: LR 154
author: Let Us All Rejoice
snippet: Look to your covenant, O Lord, and forget not the life of your poor ones for ever. Arise, O God, and defend your cause, and forget not the cries of those who seek you.

title: Responsorial Psalm - 19th Sunday A
author: Psalm 85: 9, 10, 11-12, 13-14
snippet: Lord, let us see your kindness, and grant us your salvation.

title: Gospel Acclamation - 19th Sunday A
author: Psalm 130:5
snippet: I wait for the Lord; my soul waits for his word.

title: Be Not Far from Me
author: Timothy R. Smith
snippet: Be not far from me when trouble is near. Lord, deliver me from my fear. Be my sure defense through storming rage, My rock, my deliverer, ever age to age.

title: LR 155
author: Let Us All Rejoice
snippet: O Jerusalem, glorify the Lord, who gives you your fill of finest wheat.

title: Do This in Memory of Me
author: Chris Muglia.
snippet: I am the bread of life; All who believe in me will have eternal life. I am the bread of life; Come down from heaven so that all who eats this bread will never die.

title: Come to Jesus
author: Josh Blakesley
snippet: People of the God of ages Welcome to your brand new day Leave the world and all it's trappings Come into Amazing Grace Let go your every fear There is only mercy here

title: At The Name
author: Joshua Blakesley and Sarah Hart
snippet: You took upon yourself our cruel and heavy cross. You conquered death itself to ransom all the lost, humbled yourself before a world of sin.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lord, have mercy. Christ have mercy. Lord have mercy

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Glory to God! Glory to God in the highest, and on earth, peace to people of goodwill.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Holy, holy, holy Lord God of hosts. Heaven and earth are full of your glory. Hosanna in the highest. Blessed is he who comes in the moment of the Lord. Hosanna in the highest.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: When we eat this bread and drink this cup, we proclaim your death, O Lord, until you come again.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lamb of God, You take away the sins of the world; have mercy, have mercy on us.
